description: This file defines inline functions for encryption and decryption (NEA1, NEA2, NEA3) used in security protocols, including key and IV construction, keystream generation, and bit-tailing, within the ocudu::security namespace.

methods.name: security_nea1
methods.description: Performs encryption/decryption using the S3G algorithm with key, count, bearer, and direction parameters, processing the message buffer.

methods.name: security_nea2
methods.description: Performs encryption/decryption using AES in CTR mode with key, count, bearer, and direction parameters, processing the message buffer.

methods.name: security_nea3
methods.description: Performs encryption/decryption using ZUC algorithm with key, count, bearer, and direction parameters, processing the message buffer.
